slope.processing: Elevation bilinear-reprojected to local NAD83 UTM at 10 m; central-difference slope in degrees, checked 0-90 before rendering. Classes <23° #e0e7e1 and ≥23° #4d7778; nearest-neighbor display. Not a reconstruction of HM23. Census 2026 areal water and source no-data transparent; water extent is not date-matched. Display resampling supplies no new detail.

value.method: Pixel-center selection on original UTM raster grid with equal-sized cells. Shares use valid pixels; boundaries use <= upper cutoff. Cutoffs approximate the fire-specific preliminary BARC thresholds using the conversion supplied in the existing metadata. Not a field-validated soil severity classification or a reconstruction of HM23.

Bilinear elevation reprojection to NAD83 / UTM 10N at 10 m; central differences; degrees(arctan(hypot(dz/dx,dz/dy))); classify < threshold and >= threshold; nearest-neighbor class reprojection to Web Mercator display. NaNs remain transparent. Water is not separately masked.
value.limitations: Static terrain context, not a new model input or a reconstruction of HM23. Tile edition is not a per-pixel acquisition date. Display pixels are resampled, not native 10 m cells.

datedImagery.method: Full original BAER subset; nearest-neighbor reprojection onto one Web Mercator grid. Bands 6/4/3 (SWIR2/NIR/red), DN / 400, fixed 0-0.6 reflectance stretch on both dates. Shared finite mask; no interpolation across missing data. Original reflectance and all analytical summaries unchanged.
datedImagery.limitations: 30 m source pixels; display resampling is not new detail. Non-nodata coverage is not cloud-free coverage. Rotated source edges and missing pixels remain transparent. The finite image extent is not the fire perimeter. Dates describe only these images, not any background basemap.
